contracts.completion_boundary: The originating IPMI response is 0x00 once event 0xbb is queued. Later status is internal task/progress state and is not returned to that request.
contracts.effect: Open and mmap `/tmp/bios_rom`; derive flash regions from image header fields; invoke update_bios, which initializes flash, conditionally preserves configured regions, erases/programs with retry helpers, records task state 7 on success or 9 on failure, releases update lock 2, and removes the image on terminal paths.
contracts.filesystem_contract: The queued message is eight zero bytes, so this path creates/uses task ID zero and does not take slavetask_bios_update's optional post-update shell-command branch.
residuals: Cryptographic authenticity policy and rollback behavior were not established in this bounded consumer trace.
The consumer reads image header byte 0x16 and a header-selected table entry without an explicit st_size bound check before those reads; exploitability is not established.

contracts.completion_boundary: The originating IPMI response is already 0x00 after event 0xc7 is queued. Callback, unlink and reboot outcomes are not returned to that response.
contracts.effect: Interpret each request byte as an app-group/bit selector. In the exact table, group 0 bit 0 (app ID 1) calls restore_sdr_settings, which unlinks `/nv/SDRBlock`; group 0 bit 1 (app ID 2) calls restore_ssl_certificate, which unlinks `/nv/server.pem`. After all selected callbacks, run `reboot`.
contracts.filesystem_contract: Only the two exact rtd_apps entries are actionable: app ID 1 deletes `/nv/SDRBlock`; app ID 2 deletes `/nv/server.pem`. Unlink failures are logged but do not suppress the final reboot command.
residuals: The post-reboot regeneration policy for the deleted SDR and certificate files is not established by this consumer trace.
Live reboot completion is not tested.

contracts.completion_boundary: The originating IPMI response is already 0x00 after event 0xc8 is queued. Callback, unlink, restore and cold-reset outcomes are not returned to that response.
contracts.effect: Build a per-group preservation mask from request bytes; skip each rtd_apps callback whose app bit is selected and invoke callbacks whose bit is not selected. Thus app ID 1 preserves `/nv/SDRBlock` and app ID 2 preserves `/nv/server.pem` when selected; invoked callbacks unlink those files. Then execute the same exact UtilFactoryDefault(mode=1) provider used by event 0xb6.
contracts.filesystem_contract: The preservation mask's 12-byte stack storage is never initialized before request bytes are ORed into it. A requested bit is reliably set, but an omitted bit can remain spuriously set from prior stack contents, so deletion of unselected app entries is not deterministic from the request alone.
residuals: The uninitialized preservation mask is a decoded correctness defect; practical security impact is not established.
Runtime rm_ex_files still controls part of the later UtilFactoryDefault file-preservation set.
Live cold-reset completion is not tested.

contracts.completion_boundary: The originating IPMI command always returned immediate 0x00. The later I2C result is log-only and cannot change that response.
contracts.effect: Read the event's two-byte source metadata, obtain the BMC controller address, wait two seconds, then submit a two-byte platform-I2C transaction with command byte 0x10. A nonzero I2C result is logged as `Set Event Receiver Fail`; both temporary 0x678-byte buffers are freed.
contracts.filesystem_contract: None decoded; the consumer performs a platform-I2C request rather than a filesystem mutation.
residuals: The final I2C target device/register semantics are not established by this bounded trace.
The consumer does not check either malloc result before dereferencing the allocated buffers; practical reachability under allocation failure is not established.
No live I2C transaction is attempted.
